sections.title: 2. Company Background
sections.text:
* The company was founded more than 25 years ago (in 1998) with the mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful [1][2].
* Alphabet is structured as a collection of businesses, the largest of which is Google [13].
* Google is reported in two segments: Google Services and Google Cloud, while all non-Google businesses are reported collectively as Other Bets [2].
* Alphabet-level activities support these businesses by centralizing certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing frontier models [2].
* Core products and platforms within Google Services include ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Gemini, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube [1].
* Google Services generates revenues primarily by delivering performance and brand advertising across Google Search and other properties, YouTube, and Google Network partners' properties [4].

sections.text:
* Failing to provide superior value or deliver advertisements effectively and competitively could harm the company's business, reputation, financial condition, and operating results [6].
* Adverse macroeconomic conditions can affect the demand for advertising and advertiser spending amounts, which could harm financial condition and operating results [6].
* Increasing investment in new businesses, products, services, and technologies is inherently risky and could divert management attention and harm the business, financial condition, and operating results [6].
* The company generates a significant portion of its revenues (more than 70% of total revenues in 2025) from online advertising, meaning reduced advertiser spending, partner losses, shifts in online advertising, new formats, or ad-blocking technologies could harm the business [7].
* Acquisitions, joint ventures, investments, and divestitures are important to corporate strategy but could result in operating difficulties, dilution, and unforeseen expenditures that harm financial condition and results [8].

We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets. Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. Access and Technology for Everyone
The Internet is one of the world’s most powerful equalizers; it propels ideas, people, and businesses large and small. Our mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful is as relevant today as it was when we were founded in 1998.

The time frame from date of purchase to placement in service of these assets may extend from months to years. Depreciation of our property and equipment commences when such assets are ready for their intended use.
